welcome:
👋 **Hello!**

I am a media downloader bot.
Send me links from **Instagram**, **TikTok**, **YouTube Shorts**, **Twitter/X**, **VK Clips**, **Reddit**, or **Pinterest**, and I'll download and send the video directly to you!
reactions_menu_title:
🎭 **Media reaction buttons settings:**
Click emojis to toggle them on or off:
prompt_custom_emojis:
✏️ **Send a message with your emoji list separated by spaces or consecutively (up to 20 emojis):**

Example: `👍 🔥 🤡 💩 🚀 ⚡️ 🍕`
custom_emojis_saved:
✅ **Reactions set successfully saved!**

New buttons under media:
error_custom_emojis_invalid: ❌ **Error**: Send only emojis (no text, letters, numbers, or links).
error_custom_emojis_empty: ⚠️ **Error**: No emojis found in your message.
error_download: ❌ Failed to download video. The link might be private, invalid, or unavailable.
error_too_large: ⚠️ Video file size exceeds Telegram's 50MB limit.
error_admin_only: ⚠️ Only group administrators can change group settings.
duplicate_warning: ♻️ {author}, this video was already sent recently by {first_author}!
duplicate_warning_self: ♻️ {author}, you already sent this video recently!
